summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests lorigerlimab, a bispecific protein that binds PD-1 and CTLA-4, in people with platinum-resistant ovarian cancer or clear cell gynecologic cancers. Lorigerlimab is given by intravenous infusion on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle, and treatment continues until cancer progresses, side effects become unacceptable, consent is withdrawn, or the study ends. The main outcome is not stated; the study is Phase 2 and will assess efficacy and safety.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa lorigerlimab, una proteína biespecífica que se une a PD-1 y CTLA-4, en personas con cáncer de ovario resistente a platino o cánceres ginecológicos de células claras. Se administra por infusión intravenosa el día 1 de cada ciclo de 21 días, y el tratamiento continúa hasta que el cáncer progrese, haya efectos secundarios inaceptables, la persona retire su consentimiento o termine el estudio. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; el estudio es de fase 2 y evaluará la eficacia y la seguridad.
who_for: High-grade serous ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer resistant to platinum chemotherapy, with 1 to 3 prior lines.
Clear cell carcinoma of the ovary, endometrium, vagina, vulva, or cervix, with at least 1 prior line of therapy.
Persistent or recurrent disease with documented progression.
At least one measurable lesion by RECIST v1.1.
Available tumor tissue, or willingness to undergo a biopsy.
not_for: Primary platinum-refractory disease, meaning no response or progression within 3 months of first-line platinum.
Prior checkpoint inhibitor treatment, except allowed for clear cell endometrial and cervical cancer.
Prior stem cell, tissue, or solid organ transplant.
Paracentesis within 4 weeks before starting study treatment.
